method: C3 repair persistence of arm-L checker refusals; codes ranked by repeated refusals, then persistence, then refused rounds; row text: today's checker message and hint, the most frequent pair

rows.mistake: accessible() needs rows of a table with an owner column; the profile declares none for Note, so its rows are shared
rows.fix: if each Note belongs to the user in its 'owner_id' column, declare it in profile.py: add owner='owner_id' to Note's Schema.from_pairs(...) (then every endpoint that returns or writes Note rows filters them with accessible(..., by=user)); otherwise drop accessible() and use …

rows.mistake: each statement must call exactly one table op or step (or bind a constant that uses no columns)
col("description") has no input rows here (insert() values, constants and call() arguments read no table)
rows.fix: read the value of the one row `allowed`: allowed.description

rows.mistake: 'stripped_title' is a table, not a value
rows.fix: reference a column with col("name"); pass tables to ops by name
